title: Linux eliminates the strncpy API after six years of work, 360 patches
summary: Linux kernel 7.2 officially removes the deprecated strncpy API after a 6-year migration effort involving 360 patches, replacing it with safer alternatives like strscpy to eliminate potential security vulnerabilities from unsafe string operations.
problem_solved: Eliminates unsafe string handling functions (strncpy) that can lead to buffer overflows and security vulnerabilities in kernel code.
why_valuable: Marks a significant milestone in kernel security hardening, demonstrating a systematic approach to removing decades of technical debt from critical system software.
